findings.title: Removing the context-free wrapper validation silently admits inline composition_version=4
findings.requirement: Preserve the accepted ModelProjection contract, not just validity under a different validation context. Active register Costul real masurat/remediu admis authorizes redundant-work removal only; D1 explicitly retains model-preflight v2/v3 without implicit v4 promotion.
findings.mechanism: stage_payload calls validate(composition, entry, checked_manifest, record_pool=pool). With composition_version=4 this enables method_execution and admits CONTRACT_BASE_TEXT/CONTRACT_ROLE_TEXT plus method predicates. The removed public project_model_input wrapper called validate(composition) without a manifest: inline records input is inferred as version 3, method_execution is false, and the same v4 composition is rejected (predicate/base-role contract). The new direct projection_input call does not enforce that former supported-version boundary. Thus these validations are not equivalent over the full accepted input language.
findings.reproducer: Build a genuine one-entry method_execution=True graph using existing BuildSource/CONTRACT records source. Use expanded_payload to retain its valid inline representation, reseal the composition and manifest refs, and create the real strict binding. stage_payload accepts. Pass identical owner/run/refs/approval through the original HEAD ModelProjections.prepare and candidate prepare. SQL and _verify_graph are explicitly doubled, not PG qualification.

observed.v3_positive_control: Both old and candidate ACCEPTED, one INSERT each; entire projection payload canonical bytes identical.
observed.inline_v4_stage: ACCEPTED by real stage_payload/full composer validator
observed.verify_graph_awaits: One per prepare in both implementations, observed at the explicit SOURCE double.

findings.minimal_fix: Retain a cheap explicit refusal of manifest composition_version=4 before direct projection_input (after full stage validation if retaining the existing validation sequence). Keep intra-call reuse for supported versions; do not reinstate repeated expensive validation, alter public wrapper, add cache/bypass flags or expand v4 support in this optimization. Add a same-consumer valid-inline-v4 refusal regression with the v3 byte-equality/no-write control.
findings.limits: This establishes a producer/service contract regression in SOURCE, not a PG acceptance, exfiltration, new native grant or proven live dispatch. Current fresh v4 composer output is compact and still fails projection_input because it has no inline text. The demonstrated affected form is valid inline v4; the unchanged real _verify_compositions explicitly expands either form and has no model-version narrowing guard. No full durable qualification was executed.

proposed_skill_note_for_parent: Before replacing a validation wrapper with an already-validated value, compare the accepted language under both validation contexts, including version inferred without a manifest versus version supplied by a manifest.
